shiftLock.slot: NO CABIN OVERRIDE. The ZF 8HP transmission has NO accessible shift lock release inside the cabin. Park lock is released via a special bolt threaded into a slot on the UNDERSIDE of the ZF 8HP transmission. RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — strongly preferred. Battery under hood.
steps: RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST — strongly preferred.
Connect jump pack to battery under hood.
Once powered, press brake and rotate DNA dial to N normally.
WITHOUT POWER — ZF 8HP underbody bolt method (field/emergency only):
Access the underside of the ZF 8HP transmission (jack if needed for clearance).
Locate the park lock release slot on the transmission casing.
Thread the ZF 8HP park release tool (or a compatible bolt) into the slot — this mechanically disengages the parking pawl.
Do NOT over-tighten — the tool releases when unthreaded.
NOTE: There is NO cabin-accessible slot, trim piece to pry, or interior button. Any procedure describing a slot 'near the selector base' is incorrect for this vehicle.
Apply parking brake. Chock wheels.
Battery under hood — connect jump pack.
Once powered, press brake and rotate DNA dial to N.

issues.title: EPB Manual Release Requires Motor Access
issues.detail: Without 12V power, the Giulia's EPB cannot be released without physically accessing the EPB actuator motor at the rear caliper and either directly powering it (12V to motor terminals) or manually winding the piston back. A jump start is strongly preferred.

issues.title: No Cabin Park Release — ZF 8HP Underbody Bolt Required
issues.detail: The Giulia uses a ZF 8HP transmission with electronic park lock. There is no shift lock release accessible from inside the cabin. The only mechanical override is a bolt threaded into the transmission underbody slot to release the parking pawl. Always restore 12V power first. Flatbed if power cannot be restored.

shiftLock.slot: Small cap or slot near selector base on center console
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
Locate the small cap near the selector base on the center console.
Pry off cap with a key or thin flathead.
Insert key into the slot and press firmly.
While holding, press the brake pedal.
Move selector to Neutral.
MANUAL: depress clutch fully and move gear lever to Neutral.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.

tow.method: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air.

shiftLock.slot: AUTOMATIC (rare): small cap near gear selector base on center console — pry off, insert key, press down. MANUAL TRANSMISSION (most 916): no shift lock — depress clutch, move lever to Neutral.
steps: IDENTIFY TRANSMISSION TYPE: automatic (rare) or manual (most common).
AUTOMATIC: Turn ignition to ON. Locate small cap near selector base on console.
Pry off cap with small flathead. Insert key or flathead and press firmly downward.
While holding, press brake pedal. Move selector from Park to Neutral.
MANUAL TRANSMISSION: depress clutch fully and move gear lever to Neutral.
Apply parking brake and chock wheels.
Connect jump pack to battery — under the hood, driver side.
Once 12V power is restored, press brake and shift to Neutral normally.
Manual transmission: depress clutch, select Neutral — no slot needed.

tow.method: FWD: lift from front — front (drive) wheels in the air. Flatbed preferred due to vehicle value and rarity.
notes: High-value, low-production vehicle — flatbed strongly preferred to avoid damage.

alerts.warning: Very rare in US market. High value — flatbed preferred.
alerts.notes: Manual transmission: depress clutch, select Neutral. Rare in US — mostly gray market or private imports. Parts availability is limited.

issues.title: Selespeed Cannot Shift Without Power
issues.detail: The Selespeed is an electro-hydraulic automated manual. Without 12V power it cannot disengage from gear. Always jump the battery before attempting any shift.

shiftLock.slot: TCT dual-clutch (C635): small slot near selector base on center console — mechanical override possible but TCT strongly resists without power. BATTERY IS IN THE REAR ENGINE BAY — open the REAR hood to access. RESTORE 12V POWER FIRST for reliable operation.
steps: Turn ignition to ON.
TCT dual-clutch: requires 12V power to shift — jump battery first.
Locate the shift lock slot near the selector base on the center console.
With power restored, press brake and use the paddle shifters or selector to move to Neutral.
If using mechanical slot without power: insert thin flathead, press firmly, hold while pressing brake, move to N.
TCT without power will strongly resist — apply steady firm pressure for several seconds.
Apply parking brake.
BATTERY IS IN THE REAR ENGINE BAY — open the REAR hood.
TCT dual-clutch requires 12V power to shift — restore battery first.
Connect jump pack to rear battery. Once powered, use TCT paddles/selector to select N.
FLATBED ONLY — very low clearance, carbon fiber body, mid-engine.

tow.method: RWD — FLATBED ONLY. Extremely low clearance and carbon fiber body make wheel-lift dangerous.
notes: FLATBED ONLY — very low clearance, mid-engine, carbon fiber body.
Battery is at the REAR in the engine compartment — open the rear hood, not the front frunk.
Use flatbed with padded wheel ramps only. Carbon fiber body can crack if improperly loaded.

battery.location: REAR engine compartment — open the REAR hood, NOT the front frunk
battery.warning: Battery in REAR engine bay — NOT the front frunk. Carbon fiber body — FLATBED ONLY with padded equipment.

alerts.warning: Battery in REAR engine bay, NOT the front. Mid-engine carbon body — flatbed ONLY with padded equipment.

issues.title: Battery in Rear Engine Bay
issues.detail: The 4C is mid-engine. The front 'hood' opens to a small storage frunk. The 12V battery is in the REAR engine compartment. Many operators open the front and find no battery — open the REAR hood.

issues.title: TCT Requires Power to Shift
issues.detail: The 6-speed TCT (Twin Clutch Transmission) is electro-hydraulic and will not release without 12V power. Always jump the battery before attempting to select Neutral.
